comment: The free online workshop's dated emails (23 October 2026). W1 (day before) and W2 (one hour before) load as DRAFT campaigns to the workshop group: python3 scripts/email-engine/engine.py campaigns content/email-sequences/free-workshop --live (add --update to rewrite the drafts after editing). Schedule only on Waleed's go: engine.py schedule <campaign_id> 2026-10-30 18:00 --live and engine.py schedule <campaign_id> 2026-10-31 12:00 --live. W0 (instant) belongs to an automation that still needs its skeleton created in the MailerLite builder (see content/workshops/2026-10-24-kcl-medic-life/README.md); W3 (replay plus offer) is deliberately NOT loaded until Waleed settles the programme's name and price.
